subject: RM_Grellspine
departures: short, low-growing form: a squat mound kept close to the ground, not a tall bush or climbing vine
dense, tough tangle of interlocking branches with no open gaps or visible central trunk
thorns covering every branch, thick and prominent enough to see at sprite scale
branches that look hardened and toxin-adapted, as if grown in polluted ground, rather than green and leafy like a healthy shrub
